mathematical_analysis.discrepancy_explanation: The -1.32 dB gap in PROJECT_CONTEXT.md was caused by subtracting the theoretical studio-swing shift (1.3219 dB) from 29.96 dB (yielding 28.64 dB). In reality, when both prediction and ground truth are scaled identically by 219/255 and max_val=1.0, PSNR increases rather than decreases. Actual model evaluation on canonical BSD100 proves E5 achieves 29.2899 dB vs Bicubic 29.5472 dB, a real physical difference of only -0.2573 dB caused by 15-epoch undertraining.
